$comment: Canonical component taxonomy. Editorial file (like catalog.json): naming, aliases, and descriptions are curated here; per-system data in systems/<slug>/components.json maps onto these slugs and is extracted, never hand-written.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: A stack of headings that expand and collapse to reveal or hide the content beneath each one.

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline, prominent message that tells the user about a state or event they should notice.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A compact visual stand-in for a user or entity — photo, initials, or icon.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A tiny annotation attached near another element to convey status, count, or category.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: A horizontal chain of links tracing the current page's position in the site hierarchy.

components.name: Button
components.description: The fundamental trigger control: press it and something happens — submit, open, toggle, confirm.

components.name: Button group
components.description: Several related buttons presented as one connected unit.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: A month-style grid for viewing and picking dates, often the inner surface of a date picker.

components.name: Card
components.description: A bounded container that groups the content and actions belonging to a single item.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: A horizontally traversable strip of slides shown one or a few at a time.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A square toggle for a yes/no choice; in groups it lets users pick any number of options.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: A text input fused with a filtered listbox: type to narrow the options, then pick one.

components.name: Date picker
components.description: An input for choosing a date, usually pairing a field with a popover calendar.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A window layered over the page that captures the user's attention — and often their input — before they can continue.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A thin line (or labeled gap) separating groups of content.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from a screen edge over or beside the page content.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.description: A button-summoned list of actions or navigation choices, hidden until requested.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: What a view shows when there is nothing to show — ideally explaining why and offering a next step.

components.name: File upload
components.description: An input for sending files from the user's device, by browsing or dragging them in.

components.name: Footer
components.description: The closing region of a page or section, home to legal text, secondary links, and metadata.

components.name: Form
components.description: The structure that assembles inputs, labels, help text, and validation into a submittable whole.

components.name: Header
components.description: The persistent bar across the top of an app or site carrying identity and primary navigation.

components.name: Icon
components.description: A small pictographic symbol standing in for an action, object, or idea.

components.name: Keyboard key
components.description: A typographic rendering of a keyboard key, used when documenting shortcuts.

components.name: Link
components.description: Inline navigable text that takes the user somewhere else when activated.

components.name: List
components.description: A vertical arrangement of related items, plain or interactive.

components.name: Loading indicator
components.description: An animated signal that work is happening and the interface hasn't frozen.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Controls for moving through content that has been split across numbered pages.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A small interactive surface anchored to a trigger element, floating above the page.

components.name: Progress bar
components.description: A filling track that shows how much of a task has completed.

components.name: Progress steps
components.description: A visualization of a multi-step flow marking finished, current, and upcoming steps.

components.name: Radio button
components.description: A round selector used in groups where exactly one option can be chosen.

components.name: Rating
components.description: A row of symbols — usually stars — for displaying or capturing a score.

components.name: Search input
components.description: A text field purpose-built for entering search queries.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: A connected row of mutually exclusive options, part button group and part radio group.

components.name: Select
components.description: A form input that opens a list of options and holds the chosen one.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A greyed-out preview of a layout shown while its real content loads.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A draggable thumb on a track for choosing a value (or range) within bounds.

components.name: Switch
components.description: An on/off control that flips state immediately, styled like a physical switch.

components.name: Table
components.description: Rows and columns for structured data, often sortable and selectable.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A row of labeled triggers that swap between panels sharing the same space.

components.name: Text input
components.description: The single-line field for typing free text.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line field for longer free-form text.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Events laid out along an axis in chronological order.

components.name: Toast
components.description: A transient message that slides in at a screen edge, then dismisses itself.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short text bubble that appears on hover or focus to identify or explain its trigger.
